title: Habitat & Land-Use Change Maps
selected_by_owner: Owner requested continuing the Map Maker project, attached the MMHT-12 package, and explicitly required bootstrap from OPS5 on 2026-11-20.

in_scope: Author stable parcel geometry and attach optional land-use roles to existing polygon features without replacing their map or feature IDs.
Maintain explicit ordered historical, observed, proposed and custom phases, each with independently editable land cover, habitat, condition, visibility, source version and owner reference.
Compare authored before/after phase snapshots and measured parcel footprints without inferring missing states; export separate GM/player map references and complete editable drafts.
Carry Brinegate, Lantern Post and Reedbank editable samples forward from the MMHT-12 browser tester while retaining earlier cycle tools.
boundaries: Map-only authoring. No ecosystem simulation, wildlife progression, agriculture yield, forestry growth, mining rehabilitation, construction, economic transactions, ownership changes or authoritative time advancement.
Area metrics total authored parcel footprints, not polygon-union area or authoritative environmental analytics.
Standalone Chromium browser proof is not installed Unity, real-device, Android, multiplayer, engine integration or owner review acceptance.

evidence.sample_artifacts: Three editable drafts and separate GM/player map-reference JSON per sample are packaged under Cycle13/ within the uploaded ZIP.
evidence.validation: Chromium Playwright (set_content; file:// navigation blocked by harness) loaded the self-contained HTML with no JavaScript page errors. Each clean map passed documentError and orphan/duplicate state diagnostics. Player map-reference projections omitted all GM-only area/state IDs. Saved a proposed state without altering historical/current records, added/edited a later phase and saved its custom state, downloaded/parsed a player export, and retained MMHT12 examples. Exported a full editable draft via the UI; after modifying the live map, imported the prior file via the existing draft-file input and verified separate-copy restoration of original parcel label and phase states. Compact 390px layout rendered the editor without dialog horizontal overflow. No physical device, installed Unity, online or owner review acceptance.
design_sources: FEATURE_BIBLE.md and UI/Screen Design Bibles (enduring product references)

next_action: Owner reviews the three standalone habitat/land-use example maps. Begin MMHT-14 Non-Euclidean Map Authoring only on further owner direction.
successor_rule: Requires owner direction to start the next standalone HTML review cycle.

last_material_progress.evidence: MMHT-13 self-contained HTML, three editable samples, role-filtered exports, round-trip and responsive Chromium validation.

stop_reason.evidence: Bounded standalone Cycle 13 HTML tester delivered, sample data validated, exported and reimported; gameplay engines not implemented.
